Browser launch fails when browser mode is always but browser is unavailable

```elixir title="Elixir"
try do
  engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\",\"timeout\":1}}"
  {:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
  url = "https://example.com"
  result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
rescue
  error -> IO.puts(:stderr, "#{inspect(error.__struct__)}: #{Exception.message(error)}")
end
```
